text:
The review is written with verdict: pass, and it makes no code edits. I judged from the diff and the files on disk. I did not run NavCheck, load any page, or see the shots or the `show:` line in `session.jsonl`.

- **Asked and delivered:** the Merge pill (with the waiting count) is first on `/framework/ai/`, and the session page has a plain "Ready to merge →" link. NavCheck, its test, the `--no-nav` override, the call in `merge.mjs` and the index step text in `BuildProcess.js` and `DesignProcess.js` are all there. None of the fenced paths are touched. Every `/framework/ai/` page the dashboard links to exists on disk.
- **Gate can fail open:** in `Server/merge.mjs`, the click test skips itself when there is no worktree server for the branch. A branch whose only new page is one the screenshot step skips would merge unchecked.
- **Not shown in the diff:** `/framework/ai/sessions/v/review/` and `/framework/ai/asks/undone/` get no pill, and the 7-day census list isn't in the diff either. They may be reached from `v/` and `asks/`, so the deputy should check the census list.
- **Smaller points:** the Live row links `/live/` to itself, and the check skips every `tasks/` folder.

The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/sessions-and-tasks/deputy/nav-links/review.md`.
